primary.title: The Periodic Law of Chemical Elements
primary.author: Dmitri Mendeleev
primary.rationale: Mendeleev's seminal paper outlining his discovery of the periodic law and the periodic table. This is his most significant primary contribution.

primary.title: Principles of Chemistry
primary.author: Dmitri Mendeleev
primary.rationale: Mendeleev's comprehensive textbook, which was highly influential and went through multiple editions. It provides extensive insight into his scientific thinking and the state of chemistry at the time.

secondary.title: Mendeleyev: A Biography
secondary.author: Daniel E. Stromer
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive biography of Mendeleev, offering detailed historical context and analysis of his scientific work and life.

secondary.title: The Periodic Table: Its Story and Its Legacy
secondary.author: Marcos Breuer
secondary.rationale: This book provides a modern scholarly analysis of the development and impact of the periodic table, with significant focus on Mendeleev's role.

secondary.title: Dmitri Mendeleev and the Discovery of the Periodic Law
secondary.author: J. E. McMurry
secondary.rationale: An academic article that specifically examines Mendeleev's process and the significance of his discovery, published in a relevant historical journal.

suggestions.notes: Finding direct translations of Mendeleev's original Russian texts on platforms like Project Gutenberg can be challenging. Wikisource and Internet Archive are more likely to host English translations or related historical documents.
